notes: V113 Haigen's Life Builder Chapter One. In autonomous mode he independently decides which missing homestead structure to build (coop, kitchen garden or wood shed), clears camp debris, gathers real wood/stone/twigs, spends resources in three work stages, and completes functioning buildings. Earthy timber-and-stone scaffolding, moving hammer and dust, visible project status in his notebook, and fewer repetitive collection notes. Existing saves and completed buildings, player control, companion stories, original Ember and Silent Pond are preserved. AI remains a bounded local simulation.
